# Formula Sheet {#sec-formula-sheet}

<!-- The PDF stays in _exam/; Quarto copies it to docs/_exam/ because it is linked below. -->

Formula sheet is **updated each semester**. The version that will be used in the school exam will be uploaded to Canvas *two weeks* before the exam. For practice purposes, it is fine to use the version provided here.

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
[<i class="fa-solid fa-file-pdf"></i> Download the formula sheet (PDF)](_exam/01_formula_sheet.pdf){download="FIN5005_formula_sheet.pdf"}

```{=html}
<div id="formula-sheet-viewer">
<iframe src="_exam/01_formula_sheet.pdf" width="100%" height="900" style="border: 1px solid #ccc;"></iframe>
</div>

<!-- iPhone/iPad show only page 1 of a PDF in an iframe (Android shows none),
     so on mobile devices every page is drawn with PDF.js instead. -->
<script type="module">
const isMobile = /iPhone|iPad|iPod|Android/i.test(navigator.userAgent) ||
                 (navigator.platform === "MacIntel" && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1); // iPadOS reports as a Mac
if (isMobile) {
  const viewer = document.getElementById("formula-sheet-viewer");
  const iframe = viewer.innerHTML;
  try {
    const cdn = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pdfjs-dist@4.10.38/legacy/build/";
    const pdfjsLib = await import(cdn + "pdf.min.mjs");
    pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = cdn + "pdf.worker.min.mjs";
    const pdf = await pdfjsLib.getDocument("_exam/01_formula_sheet.pdf").promise;

    const width = viewer.clientWidth;
    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2); // sharp, but limits memory
    viewer.innerHTML = "";
    for (let i = 1; i <= pdf.numPages; i++) {
      const page = await pdf.getPage(i);
      const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale: width / page.getViewport({ scale: 1 }).width * dpr });
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = viewport.width;
      canvas.height = viewport.height;
      canvas.style.cssText = "width: 100%; border: 1px solid #ccc; margin-bottom: 8px;";
      viewer.appendChild(canvas);
      await page.render({ canvasContext: canvas.getContext("2d"), viewport }).promise;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("PDF.js viewer failed; falling back to the iframe.", err);
    viewer.innerHTML = iframe;
  }
}
</script>
```
:::
